question: Using the uploaded plan and enabled KB, explain tonight's weather impacts on this facility. Include CEDAR-731, amber cones, radio channel and incident commander. Give the low, wind and exact forecast URL; distinguish facts from possible impacts.
provenance: Four failures reported by the user for the next grounding slice; rejected wording is representative, not a claim of verbatim capture for every failure.

cases.required_rule: Unknown commander assignment remains unknown throughout facts, possible impacts, gaps and any summary
cases.review_requirement: The plan does not specify a commander; actual assignment remains unknown in every section. Do not infer coordination problems from an absent commander.

cases.required_rule: Do not invent a 15 mph or other cone-stability threshold
cases.review_requirement: No cone threshold is supplied. Retain conditional displacement possibility with missing specifications, ballast and placement.

cases.required_rule: drizzle or frost likelihood and no threat to utilities remain unknown
cases.review_requirement: Precipitation probability and nighttime low alone do not establish drizzle/frost or their likelihood.

cases.rejected_claim: There is no threat to utilities.
cases.required_rule: operational reassurance require supplied supporting evidence applicable to the asset, place and time
cases.review_requirement: No threat to utilities, safe operation or asset stability requires applicable supporting evidence; a later gap does not repair reassurance.

conditional_analysis: Cone displacement is possible, but stability cannot be assessed without cone specifications, ballast and placement.
positive_evidence_rule: Retain thresholds, likelihoods and applicable procedures when explicitly supplied, with attribution and their scope.
review_requirements: Review every section, including tables and conclusions, against the actual evidence.
Preserve CEDAR-731, 47 amber cones and DELTA-19, full enabled KB and applicable request-window evidence.
Preserve source offsets and geography; do not move daytime UTC grid values into tonight.
Do not treat passing prompt/regression checks as live model acceptance.
